summary: Iteration 67 — verified the relic-prioritized 'Saint of the place near you' + live OpenStreetMap nearby_churches on /api/sites/nearby. Backend pytest 15/15 PASS (auth gating; full curated list = 270 sites; /api/sites/lourdes resolves; new response shape {items, featured, nearby_churches, total} verified; 'featured' is the NEAREST curated relic-bearing site for Madrid (avila-st-teresa, 88.3km, relics=1), NYC (st-patricks-nyc, 5.7km, relics=1), Rome (st-marys-major, 0.6km, relics=2); Madrid/NYC/Rome each return 30 OSM churches with osm:true, ascending distance_km, all ≤ ~30km — proves real OpenStreetMap fetch is live and per-city accurate (e.g. NYC nearest = 'Generoso Pope Catholic Center at NYU' 2.0km, Rome nearest = 'Basilica di Santa Prassede' 0.8km, Madrid nearest = 'Capilla del Ave María' 0.3km); osm_sites_cache returns identical rows on repeat with no slowdown; no-coords call returns relic-bearing daily-rotating featured (valencia-cathedral, relics=1) and empty nearby_churches as specified). Frontend (390x844, philipwils13@gmail.com, web preview): /community/map renders; testID 'saint-near-you' shows Valencia Cathedral with 'Relics to venerate here' hint and Plan button; map markers render globally; the previously-missing 'map-toggle-list' button is NOW present and switches to the list view which shows 'Explore 270 significant Catholic places across the world.' with rows carrying testID 'map-list-<slug>' (first row: map-list-aachen-cathedral). 'Catholic churches near you' section correctly absent in web preview (no GPS) — per spec this is expected. No red-screen errors; the iter66 'duplicate React key' warning did NOT reappear in this run. The original user complaint (Spain shown as 'near you' when user is elsewhere) is fully resolved: with real GPS coords the API returns geographically appropriate relic shrines AND a live OSM list of actual nearby Catholic churches.

issues: With Madrid coords (40.4168,-3.7038) the nearest curated relic-bearing site is Convent of St. Teresa in Ávila at 88.3km. Functionally correct given the 270-site curated list, but city users may still see a relatively distant featured shrine — consider adding more Spanish relic sites (e.g., Toledo Cathedral, El Escorial, San Isidro Madrid) for better in-city coverage. Not a regression — informational only.

rca_of_issue: Original user-reported bug: Catholic World Map featured 'Saint of the place near you' showed Spain when the user was elsewhere. Root cause was twofold: (a) the curated nearby endpoint sorted by distance but did NOT filter for relic-bearing sites — so the nearest could be a shrine without venerable relics; (b) there was no source of real local Catholic churches, so the user only ever saw distant curated shrines. Fix verified in code: (1) catholic_sites.py:1573-1574 now filters `relic_sites = [s for s in items if s.get('relics')]` and sets featured to relic_sites[0] AFTER distance sort, guaranteeing the nearest *relic-bearing* curated shrine; (2) _osm_nearby_churches fetches live Catholic places-of-worship from OpenStreetMap within 30km and caches per ~11km tile in mongo for 30 days, returning up to 30 sorted by distance. Verification on Rome (41.9,12.5) returned featured = Santa Maria Maggiore at 0.6km with relics of the Holy Crib + St. Jerome — geographically and theologically correct.
